title: Bedrock placing
description: Removes the 4 tick delay when placing blocks by holding down right click
body:
# Bedrock placing
Removes the vanilla 4 tick delay when placing a block by holding down right click.

## Before
![Slow Placing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/194b950ae9a070904d09032c18f5910e27a4432d.gif)
## After
![Fast Placing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7735def5f9cc317bb4514a8289b59fe0813d1714.gif)
## Disclaimer
This mod may be considered cheating on some servers please read the server rules before using a mod like this. Anticheats may flag, ban or kick players for the use of this mod. I am not responsible if you get banned or kicked from a server by using this mod.
## Neoforge support
Neoforge support works using [Sinytra Connector](https://modrinth.com/mod/connector) and [Forgified Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/forgified-fabric-api) it has not been fully tested and my have issues if you encounter any please report them on the mods github.
## Disabling
If you are a Server Owner you can disable the mod by putting the mod into your servers mod folder.
### Modpacks
You Are Free to include this mod in your Modpack.
